brief:
Egypt condemned Israeli raids at Al-Aqsa Mosque in Jerusalem on Thursday, when hundreds of Israelis stormed the holy site to mark the sixth day of Sukkot, the Jewish holiday, the Middle East Eye reported. The incident occurred during celebrations of the weeklong Jewish festival.

No further details were available on the scale of the incursion or Egyptian calls for action.
dek: Egypt condemns Israeli raid at Al-Aqsa Egypt has condemned raids by Israelis at Al-Aqsa Mosque in Jerusalem earlier on Thursday, when hundreds stormed the holy site to mark the sixth day of Sukkot, the Jewish holiday.
title: Egypt condemns Israeli raid at Al-Aqsa Mosque
